definition: A broad label covering Sinitic language varieties and contexts of standard written communication.
entry_text: A broad label covering Sinitic language varieties and contexts of standard written communication.
example: A localization manager specifies both the target spoken variety and writing convention.
label: Chinese
sense_note: Do not substitute Mandarin for the entire label.

sources.note: Questions 23 and 24 distinguish the Chinese macrolanguage (zho), Mandarin (cmn), and Yue (yue), and discuss common written context. Traditional/Simplified is a separate script distinction. Do not infer one variety from an umbrella label. This verifies the macrolanguage scope, not every boundary in the broader Sinitic grouping.
